name: hoicon
description: HỏiCon — task runner cho monorepo (backend uv, web pnpm, android gradle). Xem CLAUDE.md.

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory backend uvicorn hoicon.api.main:app --port 18000 --reload --loop asyncio:SelectorEventLoop
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev:db && pnpm db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: pnpm test:hooks && pnpm test:backend && pnpm typecheck
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
